games.title: Yugekitai: Saikyou Kami Fukkatsu Yuki Kan

games.description: The SIS crew investigates an abandoned spacecraft after two members develop a mysterious illness. This short, heavily animated science-fiction adventure follows the consequences of their encounter.
games.title: Ginsei Senshin Guynarock 2

games.description: Yumi investigates a secluded academy after a friend sent there disappears. This illustrated adventure follows a single story path, with occasional context-sensitive choices.
games.title: Love Potion

games.description: A psychological horror RPG made with Dante98. A choice at a train platform leads the protagonist into an uncanny carriage, where checking passengers' tickets becomes part of a disturbing journey.
games.title: Azusa 999

games.description: Siblings Meena and Otto can channel spiritual energy into magic. A request to gather healing plants leads them into a trap in a forest, beginning a fantasy RPG journey.
games.title: Wind's Seed

games.description: Orphaned Ken moves into the home of a wealthy woman who knew his father. Explore the household and its tangled relationships through illustrated scenes and adventure-game choices.
games.title: Fatal Relations

games.description: Lime returns in a short animated adventure divided into three areas that can be visited in any order. Story scenes carry most of the episode, with limited interaction.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 02

games.description: Lime and Bass continue hunting jewel-stealing BEM creatures in the third episode. It plays like an interactive cartoon, advancing its animated story through simple command selections.
games.title: Jewel BEM Hunter Lime Vol.03

games.description: The fourth episode places Lime at a restaurant, where Bass and an unusual octopus complicate her day. Its brief animated scenes continue the series' lightly interactive format.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 04

games.description: Thunder-wielding adventurer Raidy investigates a tower whose monsters have been abducting villagers. Explore its first-person corridors, gather equipment, and fight through the dungeon.
games.title: Lightning Warrior Raidy

games.description: At a costume convention, Lime encounters a living bag that steals outfits. This fifth installment is a short animated story with the series' familiar characters and sparse interaction.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 05

games.description: A trip to the swimming pool turns strange when a sunfish stuns the visitors. Bass confronts the creature's demonic owner in the sixth short, animated episode.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 06

games.description: Bass's stomach escapes on its own, sending the group after it in the seventh Jewel Bem Hunter Lime episode. The story unfolds through brief animated scenes.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 07

games.description: Lime and her companions visit a circus in the eighth installment, where the outing quickly goes awry. This is another short, animation-led episode.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 08

games.description: Lime faces a double who is impersonating Bass and causing trouble. The ninth episode continues the series through animated story scenes and light interaction.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 09

games.description: Lime is kidnapped, leaving Bass to rescue her in the series' twelfth and final installment. The animated finale closes the group's long-running adventure.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 12

games.description: The tenth installment is a roughly ten-minute animated story set at a bathhouse. Unlike the earlier episodes, it has essentially no player interaction.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 10

games.description: Bass and the group attend an idol event, then run into a troublesome turtle when the girls join the performance. The eleventh episode is a short animated story.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 11

games.description: A collection of twelve short animated adventures starring demon hunters Lime and Bass. Choose an episode to follow their pursuit of jewel-stealing creatures and the mishaps along the way.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime

games.description: A two-part animated adventure about future police officer Milk and schoolgirl Kurumi, who are forced to share a body. Choose an episode to follow their fight against Amon and his plant monsters.
games.title: Exciting Milk

games.description: A collection of twelve short animated adventures starring demon hunters Lime and Bass. Choose an episode to follow their pursuit of jewel-stealing creatures and the mishaps along the way.
games.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime
